distribution.transformation: Copy retained energy, experimental density and uncertainty tokens unchanged. Compare the full-support piecewise-linear interpolant, normalized only as a conditional energy law. No endpoint rescaling, physical-yield normalization or BetaShape rerun.

excluded_source_emissions.reason: The selected LNHB 1.99500 photons per parent annihilation signature belongs to subsequent positron transport. The source emits the positron itself.
EC is a decay mode, not an incident particle. The selected LNHB K/L capture probabilities do not define Auger-electron yields.

Selected LNHB emission tables do not tabulate Auger or characteristic B X-ray marginals. Legacy MIRD atomic rows are retained as cross-checks only; no alternative atomic-relaxation model is transplanted. This reference does not claim physical absence of atomic relaxation.
